name: inference-advocate
description: Reference implementation of the client side of the Accountable Inference Delivery Protocol (AIDP)

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @aidp/core && npm run build --workspace @aidp/daemon && npm run build --workspace @aidp/demo
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @aidp/core && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test --workspace @aidp/core
scripts.doctor: npm run build --workspace @aidp/core && npm run build --workspace @aidp/daemon && node packages/daemon/dist/doctor.js
